result.summary: The intersection features marked high-visibility crosswalks and curb ramps, but lacks visible pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and lack of traffic calming measures suggest a environment where vehicle speeds may be high relative to pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt within the crosswalk area could present a tripping hazard or reduce visibility of markings.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground right, within the crosswalk markings

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection and crosswalk area to ensure a smooth, level walking surface.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with faded zebra-style crosswalks and overhead traffic signals. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the long crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or physical refuge islands create significant exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a physical refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Poor Road Surface
hazards.description: Cracks and degradation in the asphalt within the crossing area could cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility ladder or continental patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the flexible bollards with a raised concrete refuge island to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides of a mixed-use street. However, the lack of traffic control devices and potential sightline obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street near the crosswalk may block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: The intersection lacks visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle flow and prioritize pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder style markings for better visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main roadway
